decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Refusal

1.	The proposed change of use to a mini-cab office would result in a loss of amenity for neighbouring residents by way of increased noise generation from cabs and patrons, particularly given the sites proposed 24 hour operation and is considered contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV-P.1.5 (Noise Pollution) and E.2.1 (Environmental Criteria) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003. 

2.	The proposed change of use to a Mini-cab office, by means of its location on a busy road with insufficient on-site parking would be likely to lead to conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safety of traffic and pedestrians on the adjoining highway.  It is therefore considered contrary to policies E.2.1 (Environmental Criteria), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) and T.4.1 (Traffic Implications of New Development) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
description: Change of use of ground floor to mini-cab office.
